home.name: Carlos
home.description:
I've been writing Python professionally since 2018, and it's still the language I reach for first.


Physics taught me to break hard problems into pieces that actually make sense — a habit that's carried straight into how I design and build software.


These days that means backend APIs, data pipelines, and automation tools, built for clients across the public and private sector — alongside my own personal projects.


I like the kind of engineering that holds up under scrutiny: scalable, maintainable, and built to last.

about.title: About Me
about.description:
I'm a Software Developer with a strong foundation in Physics, problem-solving, and software architecture. I specialize in backend development — building APIs, data processing pipelines, and automation tools with frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, and Django.

My experience spans personal projects as well as work across the public and private sector. I enjoy learning new technologies, from modern frontend tools like React to infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, and I'm always exploring ways to improve my craft.

Outside of coding, I love chess, reading, movies, music, and more.

experience.title: Backend Developer
experience.companyDescription: Company specialized in international trade and customs technology.

  • Creation and updating of MySQL tables through Alembic migrations

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer

experience.title: Backend Developer

experience.title: Backend and Database Developer
experience.description:

Main responsibilities:

experience.title: Backend Developer
experience.description:

Main responsibilities:

experience.title: Backend Developer & DevOps Engineer
